text_block_list.text:
One day, as I passed by the dance studio, 
Kiseki was there in her Racing Outfit. She 
was moving a pen while looking in the 
mirror.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ooh, Trainer! Talk about perfect timing~♪

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I need some reference photos of Racewear 
poses! Um, do you have a moment right now? 
If it's okay, could I take a few pictures 
of you?!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Thank you so much! The way the 
clothes flutter, the way they crease... 
Photographing the real thing is definitely 
the best, after all!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"First is the running part! Since that's 
something we'll absolutely need."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haaah—!

Kiseki ran back and forth in front of the 
camera several times. Taking a good, close 
look at her running in her racing 
outfit...

"The decorative fabric billows grandly in 
the wind...! The swaying bijou sparkles 
brightly...! It gives off a completely 
different impression than when standing 
still."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Pheeew! How was that?"
choice_data_list: Just watching got me all excited!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...! Right?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"This outfit is really 'made for running'♪ 
Hehe... Well then, shall we move on to the 
next?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Wahyaaaaaa!

She asked me to 'splash her with water 
with all I've got,' so I took photos while 
showering her without holding back. I 
wondered if I overdid it, but...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, mm! This fabric really does look 
fantastic when wet...♪ The way the 
droplets fall is so dramatic~!
choice_data_list: Oh! It doesn't seem worn out at all?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu♪ Actually, this material is 
resistant to water and mud!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
We want to avoid ruining the silhouette, 
after all. If you mess too much with 
character design variants, no one will 
recognize who it is!
choice_data_list: You even thought that far ahead...?!

text_block_list.text:
It seems her racing outfit is packed with 
all kinds of clever details. When I ask 
her about it...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, saying something like, "I don't 
dislike sharp Trainers"... honestly!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's right! This is a battle costume 
designed solely to make the protagonist 
look overwhelmingly cool!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa! This is the "rough draft" I sent 
to the designer! They made it based on 
this!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The frills around the waist flutter when 
running! The jewels sparkle in motion! 
These really bring out a sense of 
dynamism...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Tough, taut fabric resistant to rain and 
mud! It won't let your signature color 
fade one bit!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And what's more! The beret shows off my 
"manga-loving character," and the "kiseki" 
patch will make sure everyone remembers 
the author's name!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Just winning isn't enough. A protagonist 
needs to leave a powerful impact!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"A captivating protagonist winning in 
style! That makes it so much more 
thrilling!"

From the sheer conviction in her words, 
her passionate desire to entertain the 
race spectators— or rather, the 
readers—was unmistakable.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I got plenty of great reference material, 
so how about I start drawing right 
away...!

And so Kiseki began to draw. Wanting to 
support her earnest feelings...
choice_data_list: (Maybe I'll buy some snacks to bring!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm just going to be drawing, so it 
might not be very exciting to watch, 
ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Alright......

She stayed focused. I watched over her 
with a warm heart.

Leaving her to start drawing, I headed to 
the vending machine. When I returned with 
the drinks...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm doooone! Having reference material 
really makes all the difference!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Guhh~~~, I'm exhausted! My eyes and my 
shoulders! Is this the price of power...!
choice_data_list:
Good work today! Here, brought you some 
refreshments!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, are you sure!? I was just craving 
something sweet. Ehehe, thank you very 
much!"

Afterward, the illustration she showed me 
was even more dynamic and wonderful than 
usual. It seems my support really helped 
her out!
